title: [MOCK] CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: [MOCK] PHP Multipart Parser Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: [MOCK] PHP contains a flaw in the multipart form parser that allows remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: [MOCK] Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: [MOCK] Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN contains a heap-based buffer overflow that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.
